title: Aamaal of Ashura
introduction:
THE 10TH OF MUHARRAM (THE DAY OF ASHURA)

On this day, Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) was martyred. It is indeed the day of calamitous misfortune and sorrow for the Holy Imams (a.s.) and their adherents. The Shi’ah are recommended to stop earning worldly benefits, devote themselves to weeping and mourning the misfortunes of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.), and hold condolence ceremonies.

Ibn ‘Abbas reported: “When I accompanied Imam Ali (a.s.) in Dhi-Qar, he took out a paper comprising dictations of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) handwritten by Imam Ali himself. It contained the story of Imam al-Husayn’s martyrdom with full details. Imam Ali wept heavily and caused me to weep.”

If one offers water to people on this day, his reward will be similar to one who offered water to the companions of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) at Karbala’.

The adherents of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) are recommended to refrain from eating or drinking until late afternoon (Asr time), breaking their fast with humble food like yoghurt or milk, dressing simply in the manner of those in profound mourning.

verses.translation:
RECOMMENDED CONDOLENCE GREETING ON ASHURA:

Express sympathy to each other on this terrible occasion by addressing the following words at one another:

verses.arabic: اَعْظَمَ اللّٰهُ اُجُوْرَنَا بِمُصَابِنَا بِالْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
verses.translation: May Allah double up our rewards on account of our sorrow for (the martyrdom of) al-Husayn, peace be upon him,

verses.arabic: وَ جَعَلَنَا وَ اِيَّاكُمْ مِنَ الطَّالِبِيْنَ بِثَارِهِ
verses.translation: and may He include you and us with those who shall take revenge upon his killers

verses.arabic: مَعَ وَلِيِّهِ الْاِمَامِ الْمَهْدِيِّ مِنْ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ۔
verses.translation: with his blood-claimer; Imam al-Mahdi who belongs to the Household of Muhammad, peace be upon them all.

1. A great reward is recorded for one who repeats Surah al-Tawhid 1000 times on this day.

2. Recite Salawáat as many times as possible.

3. It is recommended, on this day, to invoke Almighty Allah to lay curse on the slayers of Imam Husayn (peace be upon him) one thousand times (1,000x) by reciting the following statement:

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ الْعَنْ قَتَلَةَ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ۔
verses.translation: O Allah, (please do) curse the slayers of al-Husayn, peace be upon him.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ الْعَنْ قَتَلَةَ الْحُسَيْنِ وَاَوْلَادِهِ وَاَصْحَابِ هِ
verses.translation: O Allah condemn and lay a curse upon the killers of Husayn (as), his family and friends

4. RECOMMENDED ZIYARAAT ON ASHURA:

• Recite Ziyarah 'Ashura and Dua Alqama
• Recite Ziyarah Nahiya (including special ziyarat of the Martyrs of Karbala)
• Recite Ziyarah of Taziyah (Condolence) after `Asr on Ashura

5. FOUR-UNIT PRAYER:

Recite a four-unit prayer (2x2), anytime between Fajr and Dhuhr: In the 1st unit after Surah al-Faatehah recite Surah al-Kafirun; in the 2nd unit recite Surah al-Tawheed; in the 3rd unit recite Surah al-Ahzab; and in the 4th unit recite Surah al-Munafiqun.

6. Say as many times as possible:

verses.arabic: فَیَا لَیْتَنِیْ کُنْتُ مَعَکُمْ فَاَفُوْزَ مَعَکُمْ فَوْزًا عَظِیْمًا
verses.translation: Would that we were with you So that we could also share the great accomplishment with you

7. Sayyid Ibn Tawus has mentioned the Dua al-Ashraat to be said on this day.

8. PRAYER COMMEMORATING ALI-ASGHAR ('A):

Remember the time Imam Husain (peace be upon him) had the bloodied body of his 6-month-old infant son Ali-Asghar in his arms. He hesitated while walking towards the tents to hand the infant's body over to the mother! Take a few steps forward and then retrace your steps to where you began 7 times. Say the following while you are moving forward and backward seven times (7x):

verses.arabic: اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَ اِنَّا اِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُوْنَ رِضًا بِقَضَاَئِهِ وَ تَسْلِيْمًا لِاَمْرِهِ
verses.translation: Verily we are Allah’s and verily unto Him we return. We are happy with His will and carry out His command.
Then go back to your place where you are standing and recite this dua:

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ عَذِّبِ الْـفَجَرَةَ الَّذِيْنَ شَاقُّوْا رَسُوْلَكَ وَ حَارَبُوْا اَوْلِيَآئَكَ وَ عَبَدُوْا غَيْرَكَ وَ اسْتَحَلُّوْا مَـحَارَمَكَ وَ الْعَنِ الْقَادَةَ وَ الْاَتْبَاعَ وَ مَنْ كَانَ مِنْهُمْ فَخَبَّ وَ اَوْضَعَ مَعَهُمْ اَوْرَضِىَ بِفِعْلِهِمْ لَعْنًا كَثِيْرًا
verses.translation: O Allah! Condemn and punish the licentious profligates who made the life of Thy Messenger miserable...

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَ عَجِّلْ فَرَجَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاجْعَلْ صَلَوَاتِكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَاسْتَنْقِذْهُمْ مِنْ اَيْدِى الْمُنَافِقِيْنَ الْمُضِلِّيْنَ وَ الْكَفَرَةِ الْجَاحِدِيْنَ وَافْتَحْ لَهُمْ فَتْحًا يَّسِيْرًا وَ اَتِحْ لَـهُمْ رَوْحًا وَ فَرَجًا قَرِيْبًا وَاجْعَلْ لَهُمْ مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ عَلٰى عَدُوِّكَ وَ عَدُوِّهِمْ سُلْطٰنًا نَّصِيْرًا
verses.translation: O my Allah, bid to bring joy and happiness quickly for “Aali Muhammad”, (the children of Muhammad)...
